top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.
Have simulated fire drills held at unexpected times.
Ensure proper usage of power strips and extension cords.

top_deficiency_types.title: Employ sufficient staff with the appropriate competencies and skills sets to carry out the functions of the food and nutrition service, including a qualified dietician.
Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.
Prevent the use of unnecessary psychotropic medications or use medications that may restrain a resident's ability to function.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.
